text:
incident-bot: Pager: production inference cluster us-east-1 experiencing elevated 5xx rate (avg 18%). Triggered by 5xx-threshold alert. Affected route: /v1/generate. Pager severity: P1.

sara: acked. I'm oncall. digging into realtime logs now.

mike: adding Veloria (enterprise) to high-priority notify list — they have dedicated reserved capacity.

dmitri: assigning infra lead. tagging @sara - can you paste the first error sample?

sara: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T11:10:12Z inference-gpu-3 ERROR 500 internal_server_error kv-cache-miss
2026-03-17T11:10:13Z inference-gpu-3 ERROR 502 transient_oom kernel-launch-failure
```
Seeing correlated kernel launch failures on node pool gpumem-3.

jess: Veloria account contacts (per account sheet): 
- Veloria Corp - primary: emily.veloria@veloria.com (CS lead)
- Veloria Pay - eng: raju@veloria.com
- Veloria Insights - ops: kate@veloria.com
They expect ticket + hourly updates.

mike: drafting tailored customer status note for Veloria: 
"Veloria team — We are investigating increased request errors impacting your reserved inference capacity in us-east-1. Engineers are performing mitigation actions; we will provide hourly updates. No data loss expected. We're prioritizing your requests and will engage a dedicated engineer for live remediation."

sara: internal status page update (proposed): 
"INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx errors on /v1/generate — us-east-1 (affected: reserved instances and some hosted routing). Impact: intermittent 5xx for some enterprise customers. Mitigation: failing nodes removed from pool; autoscaler paused for investigation; rerouting to warm standby starting +15m. ETA for broader recovery: 60-90m. Updates hourly."

dmitri: confirmed initial mitigation: cordoned 2 nodes from gpumem-3, triggered a rolling restart of runtime agents, paused autoscaler policies to avoid repeated restarts. Kickstarting reroute to warm-standby pools.

mike: suggested customer-facing language for Veloria-specific email (short): 
"Hi Emily — We detected a service degradation impacting requests routed to your reserved pool in us-east-1. Our on-call team has isolated the affected nodes and is rerouting traffic to standby capacity. We will provide an update within 60 minutes and remain on a call if you prefer. Apologies for the disruption."

sara: quick runbook checklist I'm following: 
- isolate node(s) -> cordon
- collect kernel failure traces -> /var/log/inference/kernel.log
- restart runtime agent -> systemctl restart redwood-runtime
- monitor 5xx rate and queue depth -> alert at 10%

jess: CS ops request: mike will send the tailored email + create a support ticket referencing INC-311337 with high priority. Cc: emily, raju, kate. Also propose an optional conference bridge; Veloria often requests voice for major impact.

dmitri: escalation decision: if 5xx rate remains >12% after 30m, escalate to hardware team (HW-ops) and consider live rollback to previous runtime kernel build. Notifying hw-oncall now.

statusbot: Statuspage draft created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3113370000 (private draft).

mike: leaving a short internal comm template for CSMs: 
"Customer: {Veloria} — Impact: requests failing intermittently on reserved pool in us-east-1. Current action: traffic reroute to standby, nodes cordoned, rolling restart. Next update: {ETA or next scheduled update}. POC on-call: sara. Ticket: INC-311337."

sara: handing off to dmitri for next hour. dmitri please ack and post play-by-play. I'll remain reachable for consult. :wave:

dmitri: ack. taking over. joining bridge, will post timeline. first checkpoint in 12 minutes.

mike: sent email to Veloria (copied CSMs) — awaiting confirm. will paste sent copy here once sent. :email:
